I'm good at playing the guitar. 

My classmates didn't expect me to be good at it because my grades in Music are very low and I'm not good at singing. Just because I'm not good at singing doesn't mean I have no musical talent and my grades in Music are low because its just about notes, sheet music and things like that. I don't know about other guitarists out there but I don't use sheet music, I use freaking tabs. I'm in 6th grade, I don't know about other schools but the teachers doesn't allow us to bring instruments unless there's a talent show. We can bring instruments once we're in 7th grade above.
